options.name: auth
options.setting-help: the auth scheme the cache's own Modbus clients must speak: suite (the crypt handshake) or none

options.help: the auth scheme the cache's own Modbus clients must speak: `suite` demands the crypt handshake (magic + nonce + HMAC proof of the shared key) right after every connect and drops the client on ERR/anything else; none/empty = no auth at all

options.name: auth-key
options.setting-help: the suite handshake's shared key for the cache's clients, min 16 characters (`file:<path>` reads an owner-only file)
options.help: the shared key the cache's clients prove with the suite handshake (min 16 characters); the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: auth-upstream
options.setting-help: the auth scheme the cache speaks to the upstream inverter: suite (the crypt handshake), waveshare (the gateway connection password) or none

value-help.suite: after every connect, prove the shared auth-upstream-key with the suite handshake — the inverter answers OK, or ERR and the connection fails
value-help.waveshare: after every connect, send the shared auth-upstream-key as the Waveshare TCP connection password — the gateway answers OK, or anything else/nothing and the connection fails

options.help: the auth scheme toward the upstream inverter: `suite` proves the shared auth-upstream-key with a crypt handshake right after every connect (the peer answers OK, or ERR and the connection fails — the poller keeps retrying); `waveshare` sends the shared auth-upstream-key as the Waveshare TCP connection password right after every connect (the gateway answers OK, or anything else/nothing and the connection fails — the poller keeps retrying); none/empty = no auth at all

options.name: auth-upstream-key
options.setting-help: the key the cache presents upstream: the suite handshake's shared key (min 16 characters) or the Waveshare gateway password (`file:<path>` reads an owner-only file)
options.help: the key the cache presents to the upstream inverter — the suite handshake's shared key (min 16 characters) or the Waveshare TCP connection password (non-empty ASCII, the gateway's own rule); the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)
